LESSON: POPULATION DISTRIBUTION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Population
Topic 2.2: Population Distribution

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Population Distribution
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is population spread out in the county?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe patterns of population distribution in the county
2. appreciate population distribution in the county

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe patterns of population distribution in the county

• Listen/read the idea.

• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “describe patterns of population distribution in the county” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate population distribution in the county

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “appreciate population distribution in the county” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: describe patterns of population distribution in the county

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe patterns of population distribution in the county

2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

SECTION: REMEMBER
